description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Sports Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Applications have been invited for the recruitment of a suitable person to the Post of Director General of the Department of Sports Development which is vacant at present and 06 candidates have attended the relevant interview. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to appoint Mr. S. Achchuthan, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as an Additional Commissioner of the Election Commission, who has been recommended by the Board of Interview from among the above candidates, to the said Post with effect from 2026-01-01, was approved by the Cabinet.
